card.name: Dose escalation and related dosing terms
card.fires_on: The word right after "dose" in dosing-schedule text, mostly "escalation" (also "study", "level"), and occasionally "addition" in mixing instructions.

modes.label: Dose escalation
modes.description: "escalation" or "Escal-ation" right after the word dose, describing stepwise dose increases.
